en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a traditional Old-World tavern or beer hall. The room is filled with carved wooden tables and high-backed chairs with clover-shaped openings. Along the wall hang medieval-style polearms, swords, and helmets. Behind a wooden counter is a bar area with shelves full of beer steins and jugs, framed by wrought-iron work and an arched niche. Decorative lanterns, flowers in vases, and a large tiled stove or heater are also visible, creating a rustic historic atmosphere.
